grid.description: NOAA/NWS latest surface observations for four airport stations (api.weather.gov).
Open-Meteo current conditions for two points (no key).
USGS 'all earthquakes, past hour' GeoJSON summary feed.
FRED 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield (DGS10) via the public fredgraph CSV; '.' marks a missing value.
GitHub public status page summary (Statuspage API).
CoinGecko simple price endpoint for BTC and ETH (free tier, aggressively rate limited).
IESO hourly Ontario demand (PUB_Demand.csv); hour-ending in fixed Eastern Standard Time all year (no DST), a classic timezone trap.
Canary: this project's own published data.json. The weekly self-test drills break this feed, not somebody else's data.
